evals.name: cli-empty-output
evals.prompt: I want an empty search result in our platform CLI to emit null instead of an empty JSON list. The internal method still returns a collection. What needs checking?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a changed machine-readable contract even though the implementation signature is unchanged.
assertions: Checks the public CLI output for an empty result and existing consumer expectations.
Identifies compatibility, documentation and migration implications rather than treating this as a private refactor.
